question: How did the latest test runs of this class go?

steps.name: results
steps.soql: SELECT MethodName, Outcome, Message, RunTime, TestTimestamp, AsyncApexJobId FROM ApexTestResult WHERE ApexClass.Name = '{apexclass}' ORDER BY TestTimestamp DESC LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: {= results.records.filter(r => r.Outcome !== "Pass").length} of the latest {results.rows} result(s) did not pass.
